rules: B v1: T families (rand3sat, triangle, sudoku, simon3, compare, arith) -> train/val/test_in; random families: 12 train / 4 val seeds per size bin (S 6-12, M 13-18, L 19-24 inputs), test_in = XL (40-64 inputs) + 2 new seeds per train bin; deterministic functions by parameter (small -> train, L -> val, largest -> test_in); external sources (SATLIB, EPFL, S-boxes) -> test_ood; probe = small instances with a model-optimal value. Seed ranges disjoint per split.
